responsibility: Implements the RTL auto-increment/decrement discovery pass that rewrites separate pointer-update and memory-reference instructions into target-supported pre/post increment, decrement, or modify addressing modes. It scans each basic block with DF use/def information, classifies candidate add/inc forms and address-offset states through a decision table keyed by target HAVE_PRE_/HAVE_POST_ capabilities, validates profitability and lifetime constraints, and then merges the update into MEM operands while preserving debug uses and dataflow state.
